verdicts.reason: Both have the same main defect: the two rules that should frame LAVANDER have come loose and float off the label in the empty space to the right, cutting across nothing. The label also sits low, so the bottles and bowl crowd and overlap its bottom edge. A is worse because the short rules beside LOTION are lost, and one of them lands as a stray purple dash on the left bottle's lavender sprig. B keeps those rules beside LOTION as in the original.
